be used to.en2: She is used to eating spicy food.
be used to.note: 后接名词/动名词，不接不定式。

break the ice.en2: A few games helped break the ice among strangers.
break the ice.cn2: 几个小游戏有助于陌生人之间打破僵局。
break the ice.note: 多用于社交/会议开场缓解尴尬。

by no means.en2: He is by no means a qualified teacher.
by no means.cn2: 他绝不是一个合格的老师。
by no means.note: 置系动词后或句首表强调否定。

get along with.en2: Do you get along with your new roommate?
get along with.cn2: 你和新室友相处得好吗？
get along with.note: 常与 well/badly 连用表相处状态。

in charge of.en2: Who is in charge of the kitchen tonight?

keep in touch.en2: We still keep in touch by email.
keep in touch.cn2: 我们仍通过邮件保持联系。
keep in touch.note: 常与 with sb 连用表“与…保持联系”。

no matter.en2: No matter how busy he is, he calls his mom.
no matter.cn2: 无论多忙，他都会给妈妈打电话。
no matter.note: 后接 wh-词，引导让步状语从句。

on purpose.en2: She broke the cup on purpose to get attention.
on purpose.cn2: 她故意打碎杯子以引起注意。
on purpose.note: 多放句末，表“有意而非偶然”。

put off.en2: They put off the trip because of the storm.
put off.cn2: 因暴风雨他们推迟了旅行。
put off.note: 及物短语，后接名词/动名词。

account for.en2: Women account for half of the workforce.
account for.note: 两义：解释原因 / 占比。

as a matter of fact.en2: As a matter of fact, he was the last to leave.
as a matter of fact.cn2: 事实上，他是最后一个离开的。

at stake.en2: Thousands of jobs are at stake.
at stake.cn2: 数以千计的工作岗位面临危险。
at stake.note: 常用 be 动词，表“濒危/成败攸关”。

bear in mind.en2: Bear in mind he is still a beginner.
bear in mind.cn2: 请记住他还是个初学者。
bear in mind.note: 后常接 that 从句或名词。

bring about.en2: The internet brought about huge social change.
bring about.cn2: 互联网带来了巨大的社会变革。
bring about.note: 宾语多为变化/结果类名词。

by and large.en2: By and large, customers are satisfied.
by and large.cn2: 总的来说，顾客是满意的。

cope with.en2: How do you cope with stress?
cope with.note: 宾语多为困难/压力，不接人。

get the hang of.en2: It took me weeks to get the hang of skiing.
get the hang of.cn2: 我花了好几周才掌握滑雪的窍门。

in spite of.en2: In spite of his age, he runs fast.
in spite of.cn2: 尽管年事已高，他跑得很快。
in spite of.note: 后接名词/动名词，不作连词。

in terms of.en2: In terms of health, walking helps a lot.
in terms of.cn2: 就健康而言，散步很有帮助。
in terms of.note: 后接名词，引出评价角度。

keep pace with.en2: Wages fail to keep pace with prices.

let alone.en2: She can't cook, let alone host a dinner.
let alone.cn2: 她连做饭都不会，更别提办宴席了。
let alone.note: 用于否定后递进，表“何况”。

lose track of.en2: I lost track of my old classmates.
lose track of.cn2: 我和老同学们失去了联系。
lose track of.note: 引申义“与…失联”，不只指时间。

not to mention.en2: He is smart, not to mention hardworking.
not to mention.cn2: 他很聪明，更别提还勤奋了。
not to mention.note: 用于补充递进，常用于肯定句。

on the grounds that.en2: She was fired on the grounds that she lied.
on the grounds that.cn2: 她被解雇的理由是她说谎。
on the grounds that.note: 正式语体，后接 that 从句。

run into.en2: We ran into a problem halfway.
run into.cn2: 我们中途遇到了一个问题。
run into.note: 亦表“遭遇(困难)”，不限于人。

set aside.en2: He set aside his pride and apologized.
set aside.note: 宾语可为时间/钱/情绪等。

take something for granted.en2: Don't take your health for granted.
take something for granted.cn2: 不要把健康视为理所当然。
take something for granted.note: 常用于提醒珍惜易得之物。

to some extent.en2: To some extent, the plan worked.
to some extent.cn2: 在某种程度上，这个计划奏效了。

act out.en2: He acted out his dream for the class.
act out.cn2: 他给全班表演了他的梦。
act out.note: 宾语多为故事/情绪/场景。

add a to b.en2: Add the eggs to the bowl one by one.
add a to b.cn2: 把鸡蛋一个一个加到碗里。
add a to b.note: 结构 add A to B，A、B 为名词。

add to sth.en2: The noise added to my headache.
add to sth.note: 宾语多为负面事物，表“增添”。

add up to.en2: The bills added up to 500 dollars.
add up to.cn2: 这些账单加起来有 500 美元。
add up to.note: 主语多为复数，表“总计达”。

agree on.en2: They agreed on a price at last.
agree on.cn2: 他们最终就价格达成了一致。

agree to do sth.en2: He agreed to lend me his car.
agree to do sth.note: 后接不定式，表答应去做。

apologize to sb.en2: I apologized to my friend for the mistake.
apologize to sb.cn2: 我为这个错误向朋友道了歉。
apologize to sb.note: 结构 apologize to sb for sth。

apply for.en2: She applied for a job at the bank.
apply for.cn2: 她申请了银行的一份工作。
apply for.note: 宾语多为工作/签证/奖学金。

arrive at.en2: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
arrive at.cn2: 我们提前两小时到达了机场。
arrive at.note: 后接较小地点(站/机场/结论)。

ask sb for sth.en2: He asked the waiter for a glass of water.
ask sb for sth.cn2: 他向服务员要了一杯水。
ask sb for sth.note: 结构 ask sb for sth。

ask sb. about.en2: I asked him about his trip.
ask sb. about.cn2: 我向他询问了他的旅行。

back up.en2: My family always backs me up.

bark at.en2: The dog barked at the stranger.
bark at.note: 主语多为狗，at 后接对象。

be after.en2: What are you after in the shop?

belong to.en2: The land belongs to my uncle.

bend over.en2: She bent over to tie her shoelace.

bend over backwards.en2: They bent over backwards to please the guest.
bend over backwards.cn2: 他们竭尽全力讨好客人。

break down.en2: She broke down in tears at the news.
break down.cn2: 听到消息她崩溃得哭了起来。
break down.note: 义1(机器)抛锚；义2(人)情绪崩溃。

break out / break into.en2: War broke out in the region.
break out / break into.note: break out 不及物(战争/火)；break into 及物(闯入)。

break up.en2: The meeting broke up at noon.
break up.note: 义1分手；义2(会议/人群)解散。

bring down.en2: The medicine brought down his fever.

bring in.cn2: 春天带来了温暖的天气。

bring on sth.en2: The damp air brought on his cough.
bring on sth.cn2: 潮湿的空气引发了他的咳嗽。

bring up.en2: They brought up three children in the village.
bring up.cn2: 他们在村里抚养了三个孩子。

bring up sb.en2: Her aunt brought up her younger brother.
bring up sb.cn2: 她姑妈抚养了她的弟弟。
bring up sb.note: 与 bring up 同义，强调“人”作宾。

burn up.en2: The spaceship burned up in the atmosphere.
burn up.cn2: 飞船在大气层中烧毁了。

call for.note: 表“需要/要求”，宾语为抽象名词。

call off.en2: The game was called off because of fog.

call on sb.en2: The salesperson called on several clients.
call on sb.cn2: 销售员拜访了几位客户。

cancel out.en2: The two effects canceled out in the end.
cancel out.cn2: 两种效应最终相互抵消。
cancel out.note: 表“抵消”，常指作用力/影响。

care about.en2: He cares about his friends deeply.
care about.cn2: 他非常关心他的朋友们。

care for.en2: Nurses care for the sick day and night.
care for.note: 义1照顾；义2(疑问/否定)喜欢。

carry off.en2: The disease carried off many villagers.
carry off.cn2: 这场病夺走了许多村民的生命。
carry off.note: 义1带走；义2(病/死)夺去生命。

catch up with.en2: I finally caught up with the latest news.
catch up with.cn2: 我终于赶上了最新消息。

change A for B.en2: She changed her old phone for a new one.
change A for B.cn2: 她把旧手机换成了新的。
change A for B.note: 结构 change A for B，表“以A换B”。

check in (at).en2: Passengers must check in an hour early.
check in (at).cn2: 乘客须提前一小时值机。
check in (at).note: 机场/酒店“办理入住/登机”。

cheer up.en2: Cheer up! Things will get better.
cheer up.cn2: 振作起来！情况会好转的。

clean up.note: 宾语可为房间/环境/ mess。

clear sth up.en2: The sky cleared up after the rain.
clear sth up.note: 义1澄清(误会)；义2(天气)放晴。

climb out of.en2: He climbed out of the pool slowly.
climb out of.cn2: 他慢慢从泳池里爬了出来。

climb up to.en2: The boy climbed up to the window ledge.

come across sb.en2: She came across her teacher in the park.
come across sb.cn2: 她在公园偶遇了她的老师。
come across sb.note: 偶然遇见，不用于刻意约见。

come along.en2: Come along, we are leaving now.
come along.note: 亦用于催促“快跟上/一起来”。

come back.en2: Summer will come back next year.

come from.en2: He comes from a small town.

come on.en2: Come on, you can do it!
come on.note: 催促/鼓励/不满，口语感叹。

come out.en2: Her new book came out last month.
come out.cn2: 她的新书上个月出版了。

come over to.en2: Why don't you come over to our place?

come true.en2: His dream of flying came true.

come up.en2: A new problem came up at work.
come up.cn2: 工作上出现了一个新问题。

come up with.en2: They came up with a clever idea.
come up with.cn2: 他们想出了一个聪明的点子。
come up with.note: 宾语多为想法/计划/答案。

communicate with.en2: He communicates with his son by video call.
communicate with.cn2: 他通过视频通话和儿子交流。

compare with.en2: Compared with last year, sales rose.
compare with.cn2: 与去年相比，销量上升了。

complain about/make a complain about.en2: She complained about the slow service.
complain about/make a complain about.note: complain 为动词，about 后接对象。

copy down.en2: He copied down the address carefully.
copy down.note: 宾语多为文字/数字/笔记。

cover a with b.en2: She covered the table with a cloth.
cover a with b.cn2: 她用一块布盖住了桌子。
cover a with b.note: 结构 cover A with B。

cut down.en2: You should cut down on sugar.
cut down.note: 义1砍倒(树)；义2 cut down on 减少。

cut off.en2: Our call was cut off suddenly.
cut off.cn2: 我们的通话突然被切断了。

cut out.en2: Cut out the bad part of the apple.
cut out.cn2: 把苹果坏掉的部分切掉。

cut up.en2: He cut up the meat into small pieces.

date from.en2: The castle dates from the Middle Ages.
date from.cn2: 这座城堡始建于中世纪。

deal with.en2: How do you deal with rude people?

decide on.en2: We decided on the blue one at last.
decide on.cn2: 我们最终选了蓝色的那个。
decide on.note: on 后接选定的人/物/方案。

die of / die from.en2: The old man died of old age.
die of / die from.note: die of 内因(病/老)；die from 外因(伤/事故)。

die out.note: 多指物种/习俗“逐渐消失”。

dig up.en2: We dug up the old tree stump.
dig up.cn2: 我们挖出了那棵老树桩。

dip sth into sth.en2: She dipped the pen into the ink.
dip sth into sth.note: 结构 dip A into B。

disappear into.en2: The car disappeared into the tunnel.

do well in.en2: She did well in the interview.
do well in.note: in 后接学科/活动/考试。

dream about.en2: He dreamed about his childhood home.

dream of.en2: She dreams of a better life.
dream of.note: 亦表“梦想(做某事)”，后接名词/动名词。

drip onto.note: onto 后接被滴落的物面。

drive sb mad.en2: His endless questions drive me mad.
drive sb mad.cn2: 他没完没了的问题快把我逼疯了。

drop in at / in sb / a place.en2: We dropped in at a cafe nearby.
drop in at / in sb / a place.cn2: 我们顺道去了附近一家咖啡馆。
drop in at / in sb / a place.note: drop in at 接地点；drop in on 接人。

drop sth.en2: She dropped her keys on the way.

dry up.en2: The well dried up in the drought.

eat up/use up.en2: The kids ate up the cookies.
eat up/use up.note: eat up 吃光；use up 用尽。

end with.en2: The movie ends with a happy scene.
end with.cn2: 电影以幸福的场景收尾。

fall asleep.en2: The baby fell asleep in my arms.

fall behind.en2: Don't fall behind with your rent.

fall off/down.en2: The child fell off the bike.
fall off/down.cn2: 孩子从自行车上摔了下来。
fall off/down.note: fall off 从…掉下；fall down 倒下/跌倒。

feel ashamed of.en2: He felt ashamed of his lie.
feel ashamed of.cn2: 他为自己的谎言感到羞愧。
feel ashamed of.note: of 后接感到羞愧的事。

feel like.en2: Do you feel like a cup of tea?
feel like.note: 义1想做(接动名词)；义2像(接名词)。

feel like doing sth.en2: He feels like taking a walk.

feel proud of.en2: We feel proud of our team.
feel proud of.cn2: 我们为自己的团队感到骄傲。
feel proud of.note: of 后接引以为傲的人/事。

feel sorry about.en2: I feel sorry about the delay.
feel sorry about.cn2: 我对这次延误感到抱歉。

feel sorry about doing sth.en2: She feels sorry about hurting his feelings.
feel sorry about doing sth.cn2: 她为伤害他的感情感到内疚。

feel unhappy about.en2: She felt unhappy about the result.
feel unhappy about.note: about 后接令人不快的事。

feel well.en2: After rest, he began to feel well.

fight against.cn2: 我们必须与腐败作斗争。

fight against / fight for.note: against 反对；for 拥护/争取。

fill a with b.en2: He filled the glass with juice.
fill a with b.note: 结构 fill A with B。

fill with.note: 亦可用被动 be filled with。

find out.en2: I found out he was lying.

fly at.en2: The angry dog flew at the thief.
fly at.cn2: 那只愤怒的狗扑向了小偷。
fly at.note: 表“猛扑向”，at 后接目标。

focus on doing sth.en2: He focused on learning the guitar.

force sb to do.en2: They forced him to sign the paper.
force sb to do.cn2: 他们强迫他在文件上签了字。
force sb to do.note: 结构 force sb to do。

get along well with.en2: She gets along well with her neighbors.
get along well with.cn2: 她和邻居相处得很融洽。
get along well with.note: 比 get along with 更强调“融洽”。

get back in/off/on.note: get on 上(车/马)；get off 下；get back 取回。

get close to.en2: We got close to the finish line.

get down.en2: Get down from the ladder carefully.

get down to sth / doing sth.en2: Let's get down to planning the trip.
get down to sth / doing sth.cn2: 我们来着手规划这次旅行吧。
get down to sth / doing sth.note: to 后接名词/动名词，非不定式。

get married.en2: My cousin got married last year.

get on with.en2: How are you getting on with your project?
get on with.cn2: 你的项目进展得怎么样？

get over.en2: She got over her fear of heights.
get over.cn2: 她克服了对高度的恐惧。

get ready for.en2: The kids got ready for school.
get ready for.cn2: 孩子们为学校做好了准备。

get through.en2: I can't get through to him by phone.

get to.en2: We got to the station just in time.
get to.cn2: 我们刚好准时到达车站。

get to sleep.en2: The pill helped him get to sleep.

get worried.en2: She got worried when he was late.

give away.en2: He gave away all his old books.
give away.cn2: 他把所有旧书都送人了。

give sth up.en2: He gave up smoking last year.

give...back.en2: I gave the phone back to its owner.
give...back.note: 结构 give sth back (to sb)。

go ahead.en2: The plan went ahead as scheduled.

go away.en2: The pain will go away soon.

go down.en2: The sun went down behind the hills.

go down the stairs.en2: He went down the stairs two at a time.

go inside.en2: The dog went inside the house.

go missing.en2: His wallet went missing on the bus.
go missing.cn2: 他的钱包在公交车上不见了。

go off to Guangzhou.en2: She went off to Guangzhou for a holiday.
go off to Guangzhou.note: go off to + 地名，表“前往”。

go on doing.en2: She went on talking after the break.
go on doing.cn2: 休息后她继续讲了下去。
go on doing.note: 指“不间断地继续同一动作”。

go on doing sth.en2: They went on working till midnight.
go on doing sth.note: 同 go on doing，后接动名词。

go out of date.en2: This software is going out of date.

go outside.en2: The children went outside to play.

go straight ahead.en2: Go straight ahead and you'll see the gate.
go straight ahead.cn2: 一直往前走，你就会看到大门。

go straight to.en2: He went straight to bed after dinner.

go to bed.en2: The child went to bed without a fuss.

go to sleep.en2: The baby went to sleep in minutes.

go with.en2: Would you like to go with me?

grow up.en2: He grew up in a small village.

hand in.note: 宾语多为作业/报告/申请。

hand in/out.en2: Please hand in your form by Monday.
hand in/out.cn2: 请在周一前交上你的表格。
hand in/out.note: hand in 上交；hand out 分发。

happen to sb.en2: A strange thing happened to her.
happen to sb.cn2: 一件奇怪的事发生在她身上。

happen to....en2: An accident happened to the bridge.
happen to....note: 同 happen to，to 后接对象。

hear about.en2: Did you hear about the new cafe?
hear about.cn2: 你听说那家新咖啡馆了吗？

hear from.en2: Hope to hear from you soon.
hear from.note: from 后接寄信/联系的人。

hear from sb.cn2: 我们昨天收到了他的消息。

hear of.en2: I never heard of such a rule.
hear of.cn2: 我从未听说过这样的规定。

help him.en2: Can you help him with his homework?
help him.note: help sb with sth 表“在某方面帮某人”。

help sb with.en2: She helped her dad with the dishes.

hold on.en2: Hold on, I'm putting you through.
hold on.note: 电话中“别挂”；亦可表“坚持”。

hold up.en2: He held up the trophy proudly.

hurry to.en2: He hurried to the door when the bell rang.
hurry to.cn2: 门铃响时他匆匆走向门口。
hurry to.note: to 后接匆忙前往之地。

hurry up.en2: Hurry up, the meeting starts at nine.

immediately / keep in touch with sb.note: 并列两词：immediately 立刻；keep in touch with 保持联系。

join in.en2: May I join in the game?
join in.cn2: 我可以加入这个游戏吗？

jump out of.en2: He jumped out of bed at once.
jump out of.cn2: 他立刻从床上跳了起来。

keep back.en2: The dam keeps back the floodwater.

keep on doing sth.en2: He kept on laughing at the joke.

keep still.en2: Keep still while I take the photo.
keep still.note: 表“保持不动”，多用于指令。

keep tidy.en2: Keep the desk tidy after use.

keep up.en2: Keep up the pace, don't slow down.
keep up.cn2: 保持这个节奏，别慢下来。

keep up with.en2: I can't keep up with his speed.
keep up with.note: with 后接被追赶的对象。

keep...off.en2: Keep the dog off the sofa.
keep...off.note: 结构 keep A off B。

knock into sb.en2: He knocked into me in the dark.

knock on.en2: Someone is knocking on the window.

knock out of.en2: He knocked the nail out of the wall.
knock out of.cn2: 他把钉子从墙上敲了出来。
knock out of.note: 结构 knock A out of B。

knock sb down.en2: The bus knocked the man down.
knock sb down.cn2: 公交车把那个男人撞倒了。

knock sb off.en2: The wave knocked him off the rock.
knock sb off.cn2: 浪把他从岩石上冲了下来。

knock sb out.en2: The blow knocked him out cold.

know about.en2: What do you know about this city?
know about.cn2: 你对这座城市了解多少？

struggle against.en2: They struggled against the disease for years.
struggle against.cn2: 他们与这种疾病斗争了多年。
struggle against.note: 后接对抗的对象(困难/敌人)。

suffer from.en2: The region suffers from long droughts.
suffer from.cn2: 该地区饱受长期干旱之苦。
suffer from.note: 后接疾病/困境，表“受…折磨”。

supply sb with sth.en2: The school supplies students with textbooks.
supply sb with sth.note: 结构 supply sb with sth。

take along.en2: She took along a camera on the trip.

take away.en2: The waiter took away the empty plates.

on display.en2: The old jewels are on display.
on display.cn2: 那些古老的珠宝正在展出。

on duty.en2: The policeman is on duty right now.
on duty.cn2: 那位警察现在正在值班。

on fire.en2: The old car caught on fire.

on foot.en2: We traveled to the village on foot.
on foot.cn2: 我们步行去了那个村庄。

on land.en2: The fish was thrown back on land.
on land.cn2: 那条鱼被丢回了陆地上。

on one's way to.en2: She met a friend on her way to school.
on one's way to.cn2: 她在去学校的路上遇到了朋友。

on sale.en2: The winter coats are on sale now.
on sale.cn2: 这些冬装外套现在在打折。

on second thought.en2: On second thought, I will go with you.
on second thought.cn2: 转念一想，我要和你一起去。

on the coast.en2: A quiet town lies on the coast.
on the coast.cn2: 一座宁静的小镇坐落在海滨。

on the contrary.en2: On the contrary, she refused the offer.
on the contrary.cn2: 相反，她拒绝了那个提议。

on the edge of sth.en2: The small town sits on the edge of the forest.
on the edge of sth.cn2: 那个小镇坐落在森林的边缘。

on the Internet.en2: Many small businesses sell their products on the Internet.
on the Internet.cn2: 许多小企业在互联网上销售产品。
on the Internet.note: 作地点状语，常置于句末。

on the morning of.en2: We left the hotel on the morning of the third day.
on the morning of.cn2: 我们在第三天的早晨离开了酒店。

on the other hand.en2: The plan is cheap; on the other hand, it is slow.
on the other hand.cn2: 这个方案便宜；另一方面，它很慢。

on the other side.en2: There is a small park on the other side of the river.
on the other side.cn2: 河的另一边有一个小公园。

on the side of.en2: They parked the car on the side of the hill.
on the side of.cn2: 他们把车停在山坡旁边。

on the spot.en2: The manager hired her on the spot.

on the verge of.en2: He was on the verge of crying when he heard the news.
on the verge of.cn2: 听到消息时他几乎要哭出来。

on the way.en2: I bought some snacks on the way home.
on the way.cn2: 我在回家的路上买了些零食。

on the whole.en2: On the whole, the movie was enjoyable.
on the whole.cn2: 总的来说，这部电影很好看。

on the/one's way to.en2: I met an old friend on the way to the station.
on the/one's way to.cn2: 我在去车站的路上遇见了一位老朋友。

on time.en2: Please submit your report on time.
on time.note: 表准时，区别于 in time。

on top of.en2: He put a book on top of the pile.
on top of.cn2: 他把一本书放在那堆东西上面。

on weekdays.en2: The gym is less crowded on weekdays.
on weekdays.cn2: 工作日健身房没那么挤。

out of breath.en2: She was out of breath after climbing the stairs.
out of breath.cn2: 她爬完楼梯后上气不接下气。

out of control.en2: The children were completely out of control.

out of date.en2: Her passport is out of date, so she renewed it.
out of date.cn2: 她的护照过期了，所以她续办了。

out of order.en2: The elevator is out of order today.

out of place.en2: His joke felt out of place at the meeting.
out of place.cn2: 他的笑话在会上显得格格不入。

out of stock.en2: The new phone is out of stock in this shop.
out of stock.cn2: 这款新手机在这家店售罄了。

out of the question.en2: A pay cut is out of the question for the workers.
out of the question.cn2: 降薪对工人们来说是不可能的。

out of work.en2: After the factory closed, many were out of work.
out of work.cn2: 工厂关闭后，许多人失业了。

thanks to.en2: Thanks to the rain, the fire was stopped.
thanks to.cn2: 多亏了这场雨，火被扑灭了。

under control.en2: The situation is now under control.

under the ground.en2: Some animals sleep under the ground in winter.
under the ground.cn2: 有些动物冬天在地下冬眠。

under the water.en2: We saw a fish swimming under the water.
under the water.cn2: 我们看见一条鱼在水下游动。

under way.en2: Talks between the two sides are under way.
under way.cn2: 双方的谈判正在进行中。

up to.en2: The price is up to fifty dollars.

up to date.en2: Our records are kept up to date.

with one's help.en2: With his help, I learned to swim.
with one's help.cn2: 在他的帮助下，我学会了游泳。

with the help of.en2: With the help of a dictionary, he read the book.
with the help of.cn2: 在词典的帮助下，他读完了这本书。
with the help of.note: 后接 of 加帮助者。

without / after careful consideration.en2: He signed the paper without careful consideration.
without / after careful consideration.cn2: 他未经仔细考虑就签了字。

after a while.en2: After a while, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
after a while.cn2: 过了一会儿，雨停了，太阳出来了。

all the best.en2: I wish you all the best for the exam.

all the time.en2: The baby cries all the time.

and so on.en2: We need chairs, tables, and so on for the party.
and so on.cn2: 聚会我们需要椅子、桌子，等等。

and so on....en2: You can buy pens, books, and so on at the shop.
and so on....cn2: 你可以在店里买到笔、书，等等。

as a result.en2: He missed the bus; as a result, he was late.
as a result.cn2: 他没赶上公交；结果他迟到了。

as follows.en2: The rules are as follows: no smoking, no pets.
as follows.cn2: 规则如下：禁止吸烟，禁止养宠物。

as long as.en2: We can go out as long as it doesn't rain.
as long as.cn2: 只要不下雨，我们就可以出去。

as soon as.en2: I will tell him as soon as he comes back.

as soon as possible.en2: Please finish the work as soon as possible.

at any time.en2: You may leave the room at any time.

at first.en2: At first, I found the job difficult.
at first.cn2: 起初，我觉得这份工作很难。

at last.en2: At last, the long winter came to an end.
at last.cn2: 漫长的冬天终于结束了。

at least.en2: The trip will take at least two hours.
at least.cn2: 这趟旅行至少要花两个小时。

at the moment.en2: She is on the phone at the moment.

at the same time.en2: He laughed and cried at the same time.

at this stage.en2: At this stage, we cannot change the plan.
at this stage.cn2: 现阶段我们还不能改变计划。

be dead.en2: The phone line is dead, so I couldn't call.
be dead.cn2: 电话线断了，所以我打不了。

be getting better.en2: My English is getting better every month.
be getting better.cn2: 我的英语每个月都在进步。

be neck and neck.en2: The two teams are neck and neck in the game.
be neck and neck.cn2: 两支队伍在比赛中不分上下。

believe it or not.en2: Believe it or not, I once met a famous actor.
believe it or not.cn2: 信不信由你，我曾经遇见一位名演员。

best wishes.en2: Send my best wishes to your family.
best wishes.cn2: 向你的家人致以我最美好的祝愿。

by all means.en2: By all means, take the seat by the window.
by all means.cn2: 务必坐靠窗的那个座位。

by the way.en2: By the way, have you seen my keys?
by the way.cn2: 顺便问一句，你看到我的钥匙了吗？

catch one's eye.en2: Bright lights catch my eye at night.
catch one's eye.cn2: 夜晚明亮的灯光吸引了我的注意。

each other.en2: The two sisters trust each other.

first of all.en2: First of all, let me introduce myself.
first of all.cn2: 首先，让我自我介绍一下。

for example.en2: Some fruit, for example, apples, is healthy.
for example.cn2: 有些水果，例如苹果，很健康。

for now.en2: You can stay here for now.

for sure.en2: I will come, that's for sure.

for this reason.en2: For this reason, we must start early.
for this reason.cn2: 因此，我们必须早点出发。

from an early age.en2: She loved music from an early age.

from now on.en2: From now on, I will save some money.

from that day on.en2: From that day on, they became friends.
from that day on.cn2: 从那天起，他们成了朋友。

from then on.en2: From then on, he walked to school.

have a good trip.en2: Have a good trip to Paris!

How come?.en2: How come the store is closed today?
How come?.cn2: 这家店今天怎么会关门？

I guess.en2: I guess he forgot our meeting.
I guess.cn2: 我猜他忘了我们的会面。

in a moment.en2: Dinner will be ready in a moment.

in a second.en2: Wait, I'll be there in a second.

in a short time.en2: The wound will heal in a short time.

in a way.en2: In a way, you are right about him.
in a way.cn2: 在某种程度上，你对他的看法是对的。

in addition.en2: In addition, we need more volunteers.
in addition.cn2: 此外，我们需要更多志愿者。

in fact.en2: In fact, he is my cousin.

in my opinion.en2: In my opinion, the film is too long.
in my opinion.cn2: 依我看，这部电影太长了。

in order to.en2: She studied hard in order to pass.
in order to.cn2: 她努力学习为了通过考试。

in return.en2: He gave me a gift, and I gave one in return.
in return.cn2: 他送我礼物，作为回报我也送了一份。

in that case.en2: In that case, we should cancel the plan.
in that case.cn2: 那样的话，我们应该取消计划。

in the end.en2: In the end, they won the match.

It goes without saying that.en2: It goes without saying that safety comes first.
It goes without saying that.cn2: 不用说，安全是第一位的。

It is time to do sth.en2: It is time to do the dishes.

make sure.en2: Make sure the window is shut.

make the most of.en2: We make the most of our weekend by hiking.
make the most of.cn2: 我们周末去徒步，充分利用时间。

May I have your attention?.en2: May I have your attention for a minute?

never mind.en2: Never mind, I can do it myself.

nice to meet you.en2: It is nice to meet you at last.

no wonder.en2: He studied little, no wonder he failed.
no wonder.cn2: 他没怎么学，难怪不及格。

not at all.en2: I am not tired at all.

not...at all.en2: She does not like coffee at all.
not...at all.note: not 与 at all 搭配表绝不。

now that.en2: Now that you are here, let's start.
now that.cn2: 既然你来了，我们开始吧。

of course.en2: Of course, I remember your name.

once upon a time.en2: Once upon a time, a wolf lived in the wood.
once upon a time.cn2: 很久以前，森林里住着一只狼。

one another.en2: The students helped one another with homework.
one another.cn2: 同学们互相帮助做作业。

one day.en2: One day, the truth will come out.

since then.en2: He left in 2010 and has lived abroad since then.
since then.cn2: 他2010年离开，自那以后一直住国外。

so far.en2: So far, we have finished half the work.
so far.cn2: 到目前为止，我们完成了一半工作。

such as.en2: Many cities, such as Tokyo and Paris, are very crowded.
such as.cn2: 许多城市，例如东京和巴黎，都十分拥挤。
such as.note: 用于举例，后接名词或动名词。

take it easy.en2: After the exam, just take it easy and relax at home.
take it easy.cn2: 考试后，放轻松在家休息就好。

take one's time.en2: Take your time to read the contract before signing it.
take one's time.cn2: 签合同前慢慢看，不着急。
take one's time.note: 后接 to do 或不接宾语。

thank goodness.en2: Thank goodness the rain stopped before the trip.
thank goodness.cn2: 谢天谢地，雨在出行前停了。
thank goodness.note: 表庆幸，后接句子或叹号。

that is.en2: She is my best friend, that is, my only close friend.
that is.cn2: 她是我最好的朋友，也就是说，我唯一的密友。
that is.note: 即，后接逗号作同位说明。

That's easier said than done.en2: That's easier said than done, but she kept trying.
That's easier said than done.cn2: 说起来容易做起来难，但她仍在坚持。

There is no time left.en2: We must leave now; there is no time left to waste.
There is no time left.cn2: 我们必须现在走；没有时间可浪费了。
There is no time left.note: 表时间耗尽，后接 to do。

to be honest.en2: To be honest, I prefer tea to coffee in the morning.
to be honest.cn2: 说实话，早上我更喜欢茶而非咖啡。

to cut a long story short.en2: To cut a long story short, he lost his wallet on the trip.
to cut a long story short.cn2: 简而言之，他在旅途中丢了钱包。

to one's great joy.en2: To his great joy, his son passed the difficult exam.
to one's great joy.cn2: 令他高兴的是，他儿子通过了那场难考。

watch out / look out.en2: Watch out for the dog; it may bite strangers.
watch out / look out.cn2: 当心那只狗；它可能会咬陌生人。
watch out / look out.note: 后接 for + 名词，表警告。

welcome to join.en2: If you like singing, you are welcome to join the choir.
welcome to join.cn2: 如果你喜欢唱歌，欢迎加入合唱团。

well done.en2: Well done! You finished the project ahead of time.
well done.cn2: 干得好！你提前完成了项目。

what a pity.en2: What a pity that the library is closed today.
what a pity.cn2: 真可惜，图书馆今天关门了。
what a pity.note: 后接 that 从句或叹号。

What a pity!.en2: What a pity! The match was canceled at the last minute.
What a pity!.cn2: 真可惜！比赛在最后一刻取消了。

What a shame.en2: What a shame that he couldn't come to the party.
What a shame.cn2: 真遗憾，他没能来参加派对。
What a shame.note: 后接 that 从句，表惋惜。

What happened to me?.en2: I woke up in a hospital and thought, what happened to me?
What happened to me?.cn2: 我在医院醒来，心想：我身上发生了什么？
What happened to me?.note: 疑问句式，to me 为宾语。

what if.en2: What if it rains during the outdoor wedding?
what if.cn2: 如果户外婚礼时下雨怎么办？

What is worse.en2: He lost his job, and what is worse, his car broke down.
What is worse.cn2: 他丢了工作，更糟的是，他的车还坏了。

what's more.en2: The hotel is cheap; what's more, it is very clean.
what's more.cn2: 这家旅馆便宜；更有甚者，还很干净。

What's on this weekend?.en2: What's on this weekend? Is there a market nearby?
What's on this weekend?.cn2: 这个周末有什么安排？附近有集市吗？

worse still.en2: The wind was strong, and worse still, the lights went out.
worse still.cn2: 风很大，更糟糕的是，灯还灭了。

a wonderful time.en2: They had a wonderful time during the school trip.
a wonderful time.cn2: 他们在学校旅行中度过了一段美好时光。
a wonderful time.note: 常与 have 搭配，表愉快。

accept the invitation.en2: She was glad to accept the invitation to the wedding.
accept the invitation.cn2: 她很高兴接受婚礼的邀请。

achieve one's dream.en2: He trained daily to achieve his dream of being a pilot.
achieve one's dream.cn2: 他每天训练以实现成为飞行员的梦想。

ask permission.en2: You should ask permission before using the car.
ask permission.cn2: 用这辆车前你应该先报请批准。

ask sb for help.en2: She will ask her neighbor for help with the boxes.
ask sb for help.cn2: 她会请邻居帮忙搬箱子。
ask sb for help.note: sb 换代词，for help 固定。

attack one's attention.en2: The loud music was meant to attack young people's attention.
attack one's attention.cn2: 那喧闹的音乐意在吸引年轻人的注意。
attack one's attention.note: attack 此处指吸引，后接 of。

break a record.en2: The young swimmer hopes to break a record this year.
break a record.cn2: 那位年轻游泳运动员希望今年打破一项纪录。
break a record.note: break 后接 a record 名词。

break the rules.en2: Students who break the rules may lose their points.
break the rules.cn2: 违反规则的学生可能会被扣分。
break the rules.note: break 后接 the rules 名词。

brush one's teeth.en2: He forgot to brush his teeth before going to bed.

build a career.en2: He wants to build a career as a software engineer.
build a career.cn2: 他想创立一份软件工程师的事业。
build a career.note: build 后接 a career，常 in。

catch a fish.en2: The boy tried to catch a fish with a small net.
catch a fish.cn2: 那男孩想用小网抓一条鱼。
catch a fish.note: catch 后接 a fish 名词。

catch cold.en2: If you walk in the snow, you may catch cold.
catch cold.cn2: 如果你在雪中走，可能会感冒。
catch cold.note: catch cold 不加 a，表患病。

catch/have a cold.en2: I often catch a cold in the cold winter.

change one's life.en2: The book can change her life in a quiet way.
change one's life.cn2: 那本书能默默地改变她的生活。

change one's mind.en2: He may change his mind and stay at home.
change one's mind.cn2: 他可能改变主意留在家里。

cover the events.en2: The journalist will cover the events at the festival.
cover the events.cn2: 那位记者将报道节日的各项活动。
cover the events.note: cover 此处指报道，后接 of。

cross one's arms.en2: He will cross his arms when he feels cold.

cut in half.en2: He cut the cake in half for the two kids.
cut in half.cn2: 他把蛋糕切成两半分给两个孩子。
cut in half.note: cut 后接宾语 in half。

cut the costs of sth.en2: We should cut the costs of our daily travel.
cut the costs of sth.cn2: 我们应降低日常出行的成本。
cut the costs of sth.note: cut 后接 the costs of + 名词。

do business.en2: My uncle does business with a shop in town.
do business.cn2: 我叔叔和镇上的一家店做生意。

do damage to.en2: The fire did great damage to the old building.
do damage to.cn2: 那场火对老建筑造成了巨大损害。
do damage to.note: do damage to + 名词，表损害。

do exercise.en2: My grandma likes to do exercise in the park.
do exercise.cn2: 我奶奶喜欢在公园做运动。
do exercise.note: do exercise 表锻炼，不加 a。

do one's best.en2: We did our best to help the lost child.
do one's best.cn2: 我们尽了最大努力帮助那个走失的孩子。
do one's best.note: one's 换 our/her，后接 to do。

do one's best to do sth.en2: They did their best to finish the work on time.
do one's best to do sth.cn2: 他们尽力按时完成工作。
do one's best to do sth.note: one's 换 their，后接 to do。

do one's voice.en2: She does the voice of a funny cat in the show.
do one's voice.cn2: 她在剧中为一只有趣的猫配音。
do one's voice.note: do the voice of + 角色。

do sb a favor.en2: Can you do him a favor and carry the bag?
do sb a favor.cn2: 你能帮他的忙，拎一下包吗？
do sb a favor.note: sb 换代词，a favor 固定。

do some cleaning.en2: Let's do some cleaning on Sunday morning.
do some cleaning.cn2: 我们周日早上打扫卫生吧。

do some research.en2: They do some research before buying a house.
do some research.cn2: 他们买房前会做一些调查。
do some research.note: do some research 后接 on/for。

do some research on sth.en2: We did some research on local food markets.
do some research on sth.cn2: 我们就当地食品市场做了些研究。
do some research on sth.note: on 后接研究对象的名词。

do sth by mistake.en2: He took my umbrella by mistake this morning.

do telephone interviews.en2: The team will do telephone interviews next week.
do telephone interviews.cn2: 团队下周将进行电话采访。

do the voice of.en2: He does the voice of the brave little mouse.
do the voice of.cn2: 他为那只勇敢的小老鼠配音。
do the voice of.note: of 后接被配音的角色。

don't talk with one's mouth full.en2: Children, don't talk with your mouth full at table.
don't talk with one's mouth full.cn2: 孩子们，吃饭时不要满嘴食物说话。

draw a line.en2: Please draw a line to separate the two parts.
draw a line.cn2: 请画一条线把两部分分开。
draw a line.note: draw 后接 a line 名词。

exercise one's brain.en2: Reading helps to exercise your brain every day.
exercise one's brain.cn2: 阅读有助于每天锻炼大脑。

express one's feelings.en2: He found it hard to express his feelings to her.
express one's feelings.cn2: 他发现很难向她表达感情。

fall ill.en2: The old man may fall ill on a cold night.
fall ill.note: fall ill 表患病，无宾语。

find a way.en2: We must find a way to save the little dog.
find a way.cn2: 我们必须找到救那只小狗的办法。
find a way.note: find 后接 a way to do。

fix a time.en2: Can we fix a time for the call tomorrow?
fix a time.cn2: 我们能约定明天通话的时间吗？
fix a time.note: fix 后接 a time for。

fly kites.en2: On windy days, the kids fly kites near the river.
fly kites.cn2: 有风的日子，孩子们在河边放风筝。
fly kites.note: fly kites 复数，表放风筝。

follow one's advice.en2: I decided to follow my teacher's advice.
follow one's advice.cn2: 我决定听从老师的建议。

follow one's instructions.en2: The students follow the teacher's instructions carefully.
follow one's instructions.cn2: 学生们仔细遵照老师的指示。

form a pop group.en2: The girls form a pop group at school.
form a pop group.cn2: 女孩们在学校组成了流行乐队。
form a pop group.note: form 后接 a pop group。

get a bird's-eye view of.en2: You can get a bird's-eye view of the lake from the hill.
get a bird's-eye view of.cn2: 从山上你可以鸟瞰湖泊。
get a bird's-eye view of.note: of 后接被俯瞰的景物。
